upstream_semantics: Existing exact-mapped Factor 1 lipid feature weights; abundance association is a candidate availability proxy, not ligand potency or a perturbation.
downstream_semantics: All finite, nonzero PKN-present hepatocyte Factor 1 TF footprint activities; abs(activity)>2 is a separately labelled observation-set sensitivity.
rna_semantics: Separate RNA loading vector for internal TF-target coherence; not protein activity.
direction: Original signed PKN direction: lipid -> regulatory protein -> TF, optionally via lipid-only metabolic availability hypotheses.
ph73_semantics: Existing ChEBI acid/base-normalized curated PKN; no lipid-class mapping, no cached STITCH/BRENDA. Requires explicit --include-ph73 option.
limitations: Measured bulk-liver lipid abundance does not establish hepatocyte subcellular ligand exposure.
Substrate-to-reaction edges encode potential participation, not reaction flux or net product formation.
Lipid-only reaction paths can require unmeasured co-substrates; full reaction equations must be inspected.
Observed TF inputs are terminal, so observation-set choice changes the topology and scoring background.
A high inferred score is prior-guided alignment, not causal validation.
